invariants.description: Olufsen wave speed c0 = sqrt(2/(3ρ) (k1 e^{k2 r0} + k3)) (relative 1e-9)
K_tube = ρ c0² / (m − n), i.e. the tube law reproduces the wave speed c0 at A = A0 (relative 1e-9)
at the run point the arterial wave speed is physiological, 3-15 m/s
lumped visco-elastic coefficient K_tube_visco = (2/3) Γ h / (l π r0³) (the 0D form of the Kelvin-Voigt term, alastruey2011pulse Eq. 4) (relative 1e-9)

bc_sweep.rationale: Arterial radii 1-16 mm (small arteries to the aorta, ADAN range) and lengths 0.5-20 cm; E 0.05-2 MPa (identified value to above the ADAN elastin/large-artery range); nu 0.3-0.5; wall viscosity K_M 1e3-1e5 Pa s around toro2022cerebrospinal/muller2023anatomically (3-3.6e4) and smooth-muscle fractions 0.05-0.55 (muller2023anatomically weights 0.10-0.55); Olufsen-type k1 1e5-3e6 Pa, k2 -2500..-500 m^-1, k3 2e4-1e5 Pa spanning the toro2022cerebrospinal and olufsen2000numerical sets; rho 1040-1060 kg/m^3; tube-law exponents around m = 0.5, n = 0. The Avolio/Blanco thickness-fit coefficients are swept by factors 0.5-2.

baseline.reason: candidate: compare the implied wave speed c0 = sqrt(K_tube (m - n)/rho) with measured pulse wave velocities of named arteries vs radius (e.g. the charlton2019modeling in-silico/in-vivo PWV database or avolio1980multi segment data); needs a network-level geometry table, not set up.

calibrate.note: not_applicable: algebraic constitutive relation with no dynamics; parameters are calibrated in the vessel network that uses it.
